hooks.command: jq -r '(.tool_input.content // .tool_input.new_string // "")' | grep -q '—' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Em dash character found in the content. This repo forbids the em dash: use a colon or semicolon instead."}}' || echo '{}'

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */backend/*.py) (cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/backend" && uv run ruff format "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1);; esac; } || true
